_metadata.description: Code-Facts-gated capture tier detection and readiness validation with format-preserving autofix toward Tier 1.

requirements.title: Code-Facts-gated tier detection
requirements.description: readiness derives surfaces and UI framework from Code Facts (Connect client with a filesystem fallback that records a degraded reason when Code Facts is unavailable) and decides the reachable tier: no UI → skip browser perf; UI non-React → Tier 0 only; React → Tier 0 + Tier 1; React-but-divergent → flagged. React is never assumed from the filesystem.

validation.notes: Fake Code Facts client drives the tier matrix (no-UI / non-React / React / divergent); unavailable Code Facts yields a degraded result with an explicit finding.

requirements.title: Detect Tier-1 perf-build infrastructure
requirements.description: Readiness detects the four perf-build infra pieces (vite profile-mode react-dom/profiling alias + keepNames:true, a build:profile script, lib/profiler.ts onProfilerRender, a top-level <React.Profiler> boundary) and emits a finding per missing piece with autofixable_count.

validation.notes: Fixtures cover fully-instrumented, each-single-piece-missing, and fully-bare react-vite scenarios.

requirements.title: Format-preserving readiness autofix
requirements.description: Autofix uses the shared packages/maturity-go/autofix helper to add the missing perf-build infra via format-preserving edits; dry-run is the default, --apply writes, and apply-twice is a single change (idempotent).

validation.notes: Preview/apply on a bare react-vite scenario reaches Tier-1-ready; apply-twice is a no-op; unknown fields and key order survive.
